sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your response and the volume commitment over 24 months. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We welcome the 14-day payment term and have factored this, along with the positive forecast, into our revised offer. We propose a unit price of €5.50 under these terms. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for sending your revised offer and the additional forecast data. We note your revised offer and the additional forecast data; however, volume growth was already accounted for in our previous calculation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

We are always keen to support your business, so to reciprocate your movement, we can adjust our price to €5.45 per unit for the 14-day payment term over 24 months. Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days. We trust this brings us closer to a mutually beneficial agreement.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
